steps: Create or use a separate checkout such as C:\gold-operational-research
In that separate checkout switch to feature/gold-shadow-operational-research-v1
Do not switch the active V19, Challenger C1 or P75 checkout away from its running branch
Keep all source Shadow loops running; the collector is read-only
Confirm local_config.json state_root paths if prompted
Share the generated GOLD_SHADOW_OPERATIONAL_SNAPSHOT_*.zip for audit
concurrent_write_policy: If a source ledger changes during collection, mark the snapshot non-atomic and collect again; do not stop or alter the source runtime automatically.
do_not: Do not run this branch by replacing an active Shadow checkout
Do not copy this collector into a source state root
Do not edit V19, Challenger C1 or P75 files
Do not infer zero performance from a missing optional system
